verdict.rationale: The public GitHub repository (cockroachdb/cockroach) shows the source is readable. Nothing in the pack states that the code is under an open license. Community comments describe a restrictive licensing model, with enterprise-gated features and an annual license key required even for free users, which suggests the code is source-available rather than openly licensed. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the license terms, evidence that the license is OSI-approved or otherwise open, and any confirmation that the full feature set is in the open source.
